answer: Harberger-tax crystal vault bond: each identity holds a crystal vault, self-assesses its value and pays an ember of tax, 5% of it, per epoch; any peer may buy it at that price. A 200-credit vault pays 10 tax an epoch plus a 70 lock, so 1,000 fakes pay 10,000 tax an epoch, locking 70,000, vs at most 40,000 rewards. Underpricing invites a buyout; wash-trading burns 5% a flip. One honest vault costs 10 an epoch; auditors can reprice any vault.
